basic_details.job_title: NIT Jamshedpur Project Intern Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Jamshedpur (NIT Jamshedpur) has notified 1 temporary Project Intern vacancy under advertisement number NITJSR/dme/2025/051. The position offers a pay of Rs. 10,000 per month for an initial appointment of 6 months. Candidates applying for the post must possess a B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Mechanical Engineering or M.Tech in Mechanical/Energy/Thermal. Eligible applicants must send their application in the prescribed format with self-attested supporting documents as a single PDF file through email to the Principal Investigator on or before 15 November 2026.

age_limit.details: Should not exceed 35 years as of the last date of application. Age relaxations will be provided as per Government norms and to candidates with relevant experiences.

qualification.details: B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Mechanical Engineering or M.Tech in Mechanical/Energy/Thermal.

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format provided with the official notification.
Fill in all required details accurately in the application form.
Attach self-attested copies of all supporting documents, certificates, and mark sheets.
Merge the filled application form and all supporting documents into a single PDF file.
Send the single PDF file through email to the Principal Investigator, Prof. Prabha Chand, at [email protected].
Mention the email subject as “Application for Project Intern under JCSTI sponsored project”.
important_instructions: Candidates should ensure their eligibility before applying; ineligible candidates will not be allowed. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview and/or joining the position. All terms and conditions for recruitment will be as per the guidelines of the funding agency and NIT Jamshedpur. The Institute reserves the right to cancel the recruitment without assigning any reason. Selected candidates must present original documents for verification at the time of interview and joining.

content_sections.heading: NIT Jamshedpur Project Intern at a Glance

rows.details: To design a hybrid battery thermal management system for Indian Driving Conditions
Jharkhand Council on Science, Technology and Innovation (JCSTI)
6 months (purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, extendable based on performance and fund availability)
Should not exceed 35 years as of the last date of application

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must ensure they meet the qualification and age requirements before submitting their application. B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Mechanical Engineering or M.Tech in Mechanical/Energy/Thermal. Prior knowledge of Li-ion battery and Electric Vehicles (EV) would be preferred. Should not exceed 35 years as of the last date of application. Age relaxations will be provided as per Government norms and to candidates with relevant experiences.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Project Intern will receive a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 10,000/- per month. The appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The initial appointment is for 6 months, which may be extended or terminated based on performance and project fund availability. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: NIT Jamshedpur Project Intern Job Description
content_sections.text: Work in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, NIT Jamshedpur as a project intern. Learn Battery Thermal Management for EVs and CFD analysis using Fluent.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of candidates will be carried out as per the decision of the selection committee. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Original documents of age proof, certificates, degrees, mark sheets, and other testimonials must be presented at the time of interview and joining for verification.
